page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.re6p.large is an entry-tier virtual machine instance provisioned on the KVM hypervisor. The instance is powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8269CY processor clocked at 2.5 GHz, providing two dedicated vCPUs mapped across one physical core with hyperthreading enabled. Memory capacity is configured at 8.0 GB of RAM, equating to 4.0 GB per vCPU. Hardware acceleration instructions include AVX-512 with VNNI support, AES cryptography, and BMI2 bit manipulation. The instance does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, requiring attached remote block storage, and offers a baseline network throughput of 1 Gbps.

Benchmark results reflect the constrained single-core physical footprint of the instance. In CPU assessments, the instance generated a stress-ng single-core score of 1312.39 and a multi-core score of 1746.48, placing overall compute capacity in the lower performance brackets. PassMark testing yielded a CPU score of 2151.57 and a memory score of 1515.49. Memory bandwidth tests produced 14.09 GB/sec for uncached 256 MB reads and 12.03 GB/sec for uncached writes, while cached small-block reads peaked at 97.49 GB/sec. Algorithmic throughput showed single-threaded gzip compression at 22.86 GB/sec and bzip3 decompression at 8.99 GB/sec, placing decompression capabilities in the mid-tier bracket.

Operational throughput tests recorded Redis SET operations at 1.69 million ops/sec and static web serving throughput at 2.0 GB/sec, alongside a PassMark database score of 729.61. Because the hardware relies on a single dual-threaded core and lacks bundled local NVMe storage, intensive I/O operations and parallel processing suffer from resource contention. From a qualitative cost perspective, the instance delivers a dedicated CPU execution environment suitable for small-scale background tasks, basic web serving, development workloads, and light application hosting where high-density memory or multi-core throughput is not mandatory.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.re6p.large is a virtual server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at 2.5 GHz on an x86_64 architecture. Configured with two dedicated vCPUs derived from a single physical core, the system includes 8.0 GB of system memory, a 1 Gbps baseline network interface, and no bundled local storage or GPU hardware. In performance testing, the instance achieved a stress-ng multi-core score of 1746.48, a PassMark CPU score of 2151.57, and uncached read memory bandwidth of 14.09 GB/sec. Data manipulation performance reached 8.99 GB/sec in single-threaded bzip3 decompression, alongside Redis throughput of 1.69 million SET operations per second. The server exhibits resource limitations under heavy compute or high I/O demands, making it most appropriate for lightweight web serving, low-traffic application hosting, staging environments, and basic background tasks.
